name: Praying For Government
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly governs the rise and fall of nations, directing the hearts of kings as He wills (Job 12:23; Proverbs 21:1). The Lord is the ultimate ruler over all kingdoms, and His authority surpasses earthly governments (Psalms 22:28). Believers are called to seek the peace and welfare of the cities where they dwell and to pray earnestly for their leaders, recognizing that wise counsel brings safety and stability to the people (Jeremiah 29:7; Proverbs 11:14). Even amid opposition and turmoil, God's control over nations invites His people to trust Him in interceding for government authorities.
